Stories discussed in this episode:

  • iOS 26.6 officially released, bringing multiple updates for iPhone
  • Apple patches over 75 security vulnerabilities on iPhone and over 150 on Mac, recommends updating immediately
  • AI tools including Claude and Codex recognized in Apple's security update acknowledgments today
  • Apple reportedly nearing launch of three new smart home products
  • Apple Siri settlement: Who can get compensation and how much?
